title: BUYER BEWARE!
body: At first this looked like a comparable product to another RECIPE organizer for ME. But a little less, so I bought it after a weeks trial. There was a glitch to which I contacted the developer where when you’re downloading one recipe and then go back to look at more an attempt to download it behind the first it won’t acknowledge the second attempt forcing you to go back to the website and start the process over by clicking forward to then select honeydew and finish. The developer said that shouldn’t happen, duh!!! but I figured they would make it right. Then the most aggravating part which is why you should be AWARE BEFORE PURCHASING is when I paid for the license subscription all of my 100+ recipes saved during the trial, disappeared and the lead developer, Chris H. has simply ignored me. It’s a very low rated app and it doesn’t even show up when you do searches for things that claims it can do! DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME AND MONEY!
